guide.summary: Shows, kayaking and zipline outings, water parks and a weekend market, with Old Town cafés, southern Thai dinners and sunset bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Siam Niramit Phuket is closed on Tuesdays, and Chalong Bay Rum's distillery visits and cocktail workshops need prior booking.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Siam Niramit Phuket opens every day except Tuesdays. Blue Elephant Phuket, Cafe Delight, Kan Eang Restaurant and Splash Jungle Water Park all list daily opening.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Chalong Bay Rum's distillery visits (1pm, 3pm or 5pm) and cocktail workshops run daily with prior booking. PRU serves only a set tasting menu with limited seating and no à la carte.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins and last entry
toolkit.copy: Raya's site says same-day tables are by phone or walk-in only. Flying Hanuman's last admission is at 4pm, an hour before it closes.

toolkit.label: Age rules
toolkit.copy: Splash Jungle Water Park's adult ticket covers ages 12 and up and its child ticket ages 5 to 11. Laguna Park's wooden playground is for ages 3 to 12.

guide.dek: Plan Siam Niramit Phuket for any night but Tuesday, and book distillery visits and tasting menus before you arrive.
intro: Phuket Town is where you go for southern Thai cooking in old shophouse streets. The website of Raya, at 48/1 Dibuk Road, lists opening from 10am to 10pm daily with last orders at 9.30pm, names crab meat curry with rice noodles among its signature dishes, and takes same-day tables by phone or walk-in only. Blue Elephant Phuket on Krabi Road is open from 9am to 10.30pm every day and runs a cooking school. For an easier start, Cafe Delight on Ratsada Road opens from 8am to 6pm daily, and Graph Phuket's own page lists 8.30am to 5.30pm on Phang Nga Road.

Out of town, John Gray's Sea Canoe runs Phang Nga Bay kayaking trips, including a daily Hong by Starlight departure, from its office at Ao Por in Thalang. Flying Hanuman's zipline course in Kathu is open from 8am to 5pm daily, with last admission at 4pm, and its packages start with a 30-minute canopy walk. In the evening, Siam Niramit Phuket on Chalermprakiat Road stages an 80-minute show and opens every day except Tuesdays, with tickets sold as show only or with a buffet dinner. Chalong Bay Rum's distillery visits and cocktail workshops run daily but need prior booking.

With children, Splash Jungle Water Park at Mai Khao says it is open daily from 10am to 6.30pm until further notice; its adult ticket covers ages 12 and up and its child ticket ages 5 to 11. Andamanda Phuket in Kathu is a second water park, though its site does not publish opening hours. At Laguna Phuket in Cherngtalay, Laguna Park has a visitor farm, a lake trail and a wooden playground for ages 3 to 12, and the Lifestyle Weekend Night Market runs every Saturday and Sunday from 5pm with handcrafted goods and street snacks.

For dinner, Suay in Cherngtalay opens daily from 4pm to 11pm, with a live band every Monday and Thursday. PRU at Trisara serves only a set tasting menu with limited seating, listing dinner from Tuesday to Saturday and lunch on Friday and Saturday. Baan Rim Pa in Patong now opens from 1pm to 11pm, a change its site dates from 1 November 2026, and Kan Eang Restaurant in Rawai opens every day from 10am to 11pm. For drinks, Catch Beach Club on Bang Tao Beach is open daily from 7.30am to midnight, and Kata Rocks promotes its Lounge and Bar for sunset cocktails.
summaryCards: Have lunch at Blue Elephant Phuket on Krabi Road, then see Siam Niramit Phuket's evening show on any day except Tuesday.
Cafe Delight on Ratsada Road opens at 8am daily, and KR Hangout near Kata Beach opens at 7am with coffee, pastries and bagels.
Reserve Chalong Bay Rum's distillery visit or cocktail workshop in advance, and note that PRU lists dinner from Tuesday to Saturday only.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and show details do not guarantee availability. Hours for Raya, Graph Phuket and Crème Café come from undated pages, and no hours were published for Andamanda Phuket, Laguna Park, Mom Tri's Kitchen, Ta Khai, Talung Thai, Reflections Rooftop Bar or the Kata Rocks venues. Siam Niramit's schedule labels were partly unclear in the fetched text, so only the Tuesday closure and 80-minute show length are used. Several sites could not be read: Phuket FantaSea (403), Café del Mar Phuket (522), Aquaria Phuket (certificate error), Carnival Magic and Bartels (no readable content), The Boathouse and Blue Tree Phuket (connection failures), plus several domains that no longer resolve. Big Buddha, Campus Coffee Roasters and One Chun publish only on social media, the Phuket Elephant Sanctuary gives no exact address, and no independent bakery with a readable official site was found, so the bakery list relies on KR Hangout's pastries. A first read of flyinghanuman.com reported text addressed to an AI, but a second read found none, so it is not listed as injection-like text.
injectionLikeTextIgnored: 2026-11-01: flyinghanuman.com was opened in a browser and its full HTML searched; no AI-directed text was present.
